verdict.rationale: Ramp documents the agent channels for this workflow. Agents can retrieve transactions via the Transactions API and MCP, load accounting and tracking categories, and use CLI transaction subcommands including list, edit, missing and memo-suggestions. The live MCP server also exposes transactions:write and accounting:write scopes, so an agent can read and write transaction coding. However, no evidence shows an explicit uncoded-transaction filter, agent-proposed policy flags, or a staged review queue for agent-pushed coding, as opposed to direct edits. Missing for 10: an explicit uncoded-transaction query, documented agent-set policy flags, a propose-then-review flow for pushed GL coding, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can pull uncoded transactions via API or MCP, propose categorizations and policy flags, and push clean coding back for review
